description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_Lexer', which provides an abstract base for lexing (tokenizing) HTML markup into tokens. It includes utility methods for parsing entities, normalizing HTML, and extracting body content, as well as static factory methods for creating lexer instances based on configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer
classes.description: An abstract base class for lexing HTML SGML-like markup into tokens. Provides utility functions, configuration-based instantiation, and HTML normalization methods.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a concrete lexer based on configuration. Supports 'DOMLex', 'DirectLex', and 'PH5P'. Handles tracking line numbers and compatibility checks.

methods.name: parseText
methods.description: Parses a string of text data into internal tokens, potentially with entity substitution.

methods.name: parseAttr
methods.description: Parses attribute data string, handling entity substitution.

methods.name: parseData
methods.description: Converts special HTML entities to characters within a string, with optional fallback to entity parser.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Abstract method intended to lex an HTML string into tokens; raises exception if called on base class.

methods.name: escapeCDATA
methods.description: Static method that escapes CDATA sections within a string.

methods.name: escapeCommentedCDATA
methods.description: Static method that escapes commented CDATA sections.

methods.name: CDATACallback
methods.description: Callback used during CDATA escaping to htmlspecialchars inside CDATA sections.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes HTML by converting entities, fixing encoding, removing processing instructions, and script removal based on configuration.

methods.name: extractBody
methods.description: Extracts body content from HTML document if present.
